scope: Actual source review and new read-only small-metadata validator; not scientific replay or large witness hashing.

validator.scope: stdlib-only; default no writes/subprocess/science imports; each metadata file <=2MiB, total <=256MiB; gz/zip/pdf denied

current_actual_validation.scope: Small metadata acceptance only; no scientific witness arithmetic/hash or final ZIP acceptance.

tests.name: tie chooses smallest S among certified
same row count does not excuse duplicate/missing key
pending earlier member blocks first success
negative gap fake positive power rejected
missing power is not numeric zero
PFA equality is not strict pass
physical identity aliases ignore labels but preserve rows
wrong readout is not an identity alias
scientific witness type blocked before read

source_findings.mechanism: all(empty) and no exact declared-key-set guard can treat a deleted predecessor/current member as complete; total400 alone can hide duplicate/missing keys.
source_findings.current_effect: Current 400-key snapshot independently matched; no false first-success found.
source_findings.minimal_fix: Validate exact expected keys+uniqueness; require nonempty expected current group and every expected member closed before selection.

source_findings.mechanism: physical_rule_status initialized PASS before contract assertion; caught validation errors only mark direction/contract failure.
source_findings.current_effect: All current frozen calendar records passed independent timing/calendar checks; no incorrect physical row found.
source_findings.minimal_fix: Initialize NOT_CHECKED; assign physical PASS only after checks; on timing/contract failure set PHYSICAL_CONTRACT_FAILED separately from projection failure.

source_findings.mechanism: target_classification only emits variance-ratio and risk-target failures; protocol EVENT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED not separately labelled.
source_findings.current_effect: Current event budgets far below limits and target failures retained; no wrong PASS caused.
source_findings.minimal_fix: Add derived event-exhaustion diagnostic without changing frozen numerical payload or silently rewriting old CASE classification.

source_findings.mechanism: all-completed intentionally skips not-yet-accepted cases and can PASS a proper subset.
source_findings.current_effect: Existing scope explicitly states not full-grid; do not conflate with full400.
source_findings.minimal_fix: Combine full400 metadata gate with artifact check and match unique accepted-reference count before final full-grid acceptance.

final_required_checks: Freeze original protocol/input hashes and exact400 tuple keyset; preserve all stage candidates, zeros, aliases and historic failures.
Every row has current classification; no NOT_RUN/pending, unbound means/variance or unreviewed unresolved execution failure promoted to PASS.
Physical timing/admission/return inherited scope and certificate/risk status separate; original>=3 reference eligibility reported separately.
Per-case full/derived receipt chain, current mean review/function digest, CASE/protocol/direction/covariance and witness bindings; exact aliases require full semantic equality.
Risk identity/strict PFA<.001/power>=.9/ratio<=1.01; both healthy/error/event budgets and negative-gap variance discipline.
First-certified-grid requires complete declared predecessor and current family sets, exact max-power/min-S tie; no continuous/sequential/global optimum claim.
After stop/freeze, actual full artifact bytes and finalactual ZIP new-extraction checks; small metadata PASS alone cannot close P5/TAC goal.
